name: Constance Ashcombe
background: Married the Colonel in 1951 and ran Ashcombe Hall for thirty years. Learned at the tea table that he had left almost everything to his brother.
motive: Disinherited, in public, an hour before Gerald died.
opportunity: Sat opposite him at the tea table.

relationships.note: Has trusted Ambrose Fairlie for thirty years.

name: Agnes Mora
background: Nursed the Colonel through his last year. Kept his medicines, including his daily digoxin. Stayed on after his death to help the widow.
motive: The Colonel promised her a legacy. The will didn't mention her.
opportunity: The only person in the house who knew the Colonel's medicines by heart.
personality: Gentle, careful, frightened of being blamed.

name: Silas Brook
background: Forty years in the Ashcombe gardens. Grows the foxgloves in the long border, and knows exactly what they can do.
motive: Gerald had told him he would be pensioned off 'before the autumn'.
opportunity: Cut foxgloves for the drawing-room vases on the morning of the reading.
personality: Slow, stubborn, and suspicious of anyone in a good suit.

name: Ambrose Fairlie
background: The Ashcombes' solicitor since 1954 and trustee of the family trust since 1962. Drew up the Colonel's will and read it aloud on Saturday.
motive: None. He had nothing to gain under the will and has been the family's friend for thirty years.
opportunity: Sat at the head of the table, reading, from four o'clock until Gerald fell.
accessLevel: The family's papers, and the Colonel's estate for probate

name: Rory Ashcombe
background: The Colonel's nephew, cut off five years ago after a scandal at university. Arrived in the village on the afternoon of the reading, uninvited.
motive: Hoped to be in the will. He wasn't.
opportunity: Was somewhere near the Hall that afternoon, and won't say where.
personality: Sardonic, defensive, younger than he looks.

relationships.note: Fairlie arranged his allowance being stopped.
